name: Slack
label: Slack — Slack Web API + Events API
description: Slack Web API at https://slack.com/api. Docs: https://api.slack.com/methods. chat.postMessage uses channel, text, blocks, thread_ts. upload-file is only files.getUploadURLExternal (filename + length) — the 3-step upload (get URL, PUT bytes, completeUploadExternal) is not a single engine call. Bearer bot_token. Handler: OfficialApiNode. Never log bot_token. Inbound webhooks: selecting the :listen operation (listen) via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) + provider signing/verification secret (signing_secret) blocks the canvas INPUT port and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start (or binds to any Activity's MESSAGE Boundary Event); selecting the :send_and_wait operation (send-and-wait) performs the outbound send and waits on correlationKey for the matching inbound webhook reply.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Slack operation. Set operation plus the fields that operation needs. Do not put secrets on this port. Files are referenced by Slack file ID (file_id). Example: {"operation":"send-message"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official call to run. EXACT values: send-message | update-message | delete-message | get-permalink | search-messages | archive-channel | close-channel | create-channel | get-channel | list-channels | channel-history | invite-channel | join-channel | kick-channel | leave-channel | list-channel-members | open-dm | rename-channel | get-replies | set-purpose | set-topic | unarchive-channel | upload-file | get-file | list-files | add-reaction | remove-reaction | list-reactions | add-star | remove-star | list-stars | get-user | list-users | update-user-profile | create-usergroup | list-usergroups | update-usergroup | send-and-wait | listen. listen (:listen role) is configured on the node via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) for inbound webhooks (blocks the canvas INPUT port); send-and-wait (:send_and_wait role) sends the outbound message and waits on correlationKey for the matching inbound webhook reply. Example: first verb.

schema.label: channel
schema.description: Channel or DM id (C… / D… / G…). Required for most conversation ops. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: text
schema.description: Message text for chat.postMessage / chat.update. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: ts
schema.description: Message timestamp id. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: thread_ts
schema.description: Parent ts to reply in-thread. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: name
schema.description: Channel name, emoji name (no colons), or usergroup name. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: users
schema.description: Comma-separated user ids for invite / open-dm. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: user
schema.description: User id for kick / users.info. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: query
schema.description: search.messages query. Requires search:read. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: filename
schema.description: Upload filename for files.getUploadURLExternal (Slack files v2). Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: length
schema.description: Byte length of the file for Slack files v2. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: file_id
schema.description: Slack file ID (sent as `file`) for get-file (files.info, required) and add-star / remove-star (star a file instead of a message). Example: F0123ABCDEF.

schema.label: blocks
schema.description: Request-body parameter `blocks` for operations: send-message, update-message.

schema.label: mrkdwn
schema.description: Request-body parameter `mrkdwn` for operation: send-message.

schema.label: message_ts
schema.description: Query-string parameter `message_ts` for operation: get-permalink. Required by: get-permalink.

schema.label: count
schema.description: Query-string parameter `count` for operations: search-messages, list-files, list-reactions, list-stars.

schema.label: page
schema.description: Query-string parameter `page` for operations: search-messages, list-files, list-reactions, list-stars.

schema.label: is_private
schema.description: Request-body parameter `is_private` for operation: create-channel.

schema.label: types
schema.description: Query-string parameter `types` for operation: list-channels.

schema.label: limit
schema.description: Query-string parameter `limit` for operations: list-channels, channel-history, list-channel-members, get-replies, list-users.

schema.label: cursor
schema.description: Query-string parameter `cursor` for operations: list-channels, channel-history, list-channel-members, get-replies, list-users.

schema.label: exclude_archived
schema.description: Query-string parameter `exclude_archived` for operation: list-channels.

schema.label: latest
schema.description: Query-string parameter `latest` for operation: channel-history.

schema.label: oldest
schema.description: Query-string parameter `oldest` for operation: channel-history.

schema.label: purpose
schema.description: Request-body parameter `purpose` for operation: set-purpose. Required by: set-purpose.

schema.label: topic
schema.description: Request-body parameter `topic` for operation: set-topic. Required by: set-topic.

schema.label: alt_txt
schema.description: Request-body parameter `alt_txt` for operation: upload-file.

schema.label: timestamp
schema.description: Request-body parameter `timestamp` for operations: add-reaction, remove-reaction, add-star, remove-star. Required by: add-reaction, remove-reaction.

schema.label: profile
schema.description: Request-body parameter `profile` for operation: update-user-profile.

schema.label: handle
schema.description: Request-body parameter `handle` for operations: create-usergroup, update-usergroup.

schema.label: channels
schema.description: Request-body parameter `channels` for operations: create-usergroup, update-usergroup.

schema.label: include_users
schema.description: Query-string parameter `include_users` for operation: list-usergroups.

schema.label: include_count
schema.description: Query-string parameter `include_count` for operation: list-usergroups.

schema.label: usergroup
schema.description: Request-body parameter `usergroup` for operation: update-usergroup. Required by: update-usergroup.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Result object. Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Inbound webhook events (:listen) and matched webhook replies (:send_and_wait) emit normalized event data on output. Secrets never appear. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Present on HTTP success. EXACT: ok.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Upstream HTTP status. Example: 200.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the provider, or raw text if not JSON. Never contains secrets.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when INPUT omits operation. EXACT: send-message, update-message, delete-message, get-permalink, search-messages, archive-channel, close-channel, create-channel, get-channel, list-channels, channel-history, invite-channel, join-channel, kick-channel, leave-channel, list-channel-members, open-dm, rename-channel, get-replies, set-purpose, set-topic, unarchive-channel, upload-file, get-file, list-files, add-reaction, remove-reaction, list-reactions, add-star, remove-star, list-stars, get-user, list-users, update-user-profile, create-usergroup, list-usergroups, update-usergroup, send-and-wait, listen. Selecting listen (:listen role) reveals webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) and provider verification fields (signing_secret), blocks the canvas INPUT port, and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start or Activity MESSAGE Boundary Event; selecting send-and-wait (:send_and_wait role) reveals the same webhook fields, sends the outbound message, and waits on correlationKey for the matching inbound webhook reply.

configurationParameters.label: Bot token
configurationParameters.description: Slack bot token (xoxb-…) or user token (xoxp-…). Header Authorization: Bearer. StudioQuack secret. Never log. Token rotation must be off for a long-lived stored token. Never log. Never put on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout for each official HTTPS call. Positive integer. Default 25. 0/blank → 25.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.

configurationParameters.label: Slack Signing Secret
configurationParameters.description: Slack App Signing Secret for constant-time v0:{timestamp}:{rawBody} HMAC-SHA256 verification (X-Slack-Signature). Never logged.
